description: List the user's notes filtered by a title substring and/or creation-date range, newest first. Returns up to 10 notes with id, title and created date. A deterministic finder, not a search: it does NOT match on content or meaning (use search_notes).

limit.description: Max notes to return. Default 10, hard-capped at 10 regardless of what's passed here.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only notes created on or after this date. Optional.

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the note title (e.g. 'Romans'). Optional — omit to not filter by title.

until.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only notes created on or before this date. Optional.

name: find_notes
title: Find notes
